title: 30th Celebration, three weeks in
headline: Our prices can see the 30th Celebration from day 12, not its launch.
dek: TCGplayer's market price for the four 30th Celebration cards on the board's first 7-day list fell 39.1% to 48.1%, Sep 28 to Oct 5. All four are unconfirmed: no sale checked on any of them. What the list doesn't show: the set's launch week, the set as a whole, or the original printings.
why_now: The board's 7-day list filled in for the first time on Oct 6, with prices from Sep 28 to Oct 5: days 12 to 19 after the Sep 16 launch. Our prices start Sep 28, so launch week isn't in them.
risk: Any of these moves may be real: unconfirmed means no sale was checked, not that anything is wrong. The list holds at most ten of the biggest moves that pass its rule, so it can't speak for the set. This is not a read on whether these prices are high or low.
what_to_watch: From the Oct 8 list the window is Sep 30 to Oct 7, the set's third week. Watch whether these four stay on it. Off the list wouldn't mean steady: a card can drop off by moving less than the tenth row, more than 60%, without its lowest listing, or below $20.
source: TCGplayer market prices via tcgcsv.com, from the board's first 7-day list (prices Sep 28 to Oct 5, 2026, published Oct 6)

foot: Market price: TCGplayer's average of recent completed sales of the same card, condition and printing (help.tcgplayer.com). Moves: the board's first 7-day list, published Oct 6, prices as of Sep 28 and Oct 5, 2026. Sep 28 prices: worked back from the listed price and its rounded change, so within 40 cents; the list doesn't publish them. The list: up to 10 cards worth $20 or more that moved 5% or more in a week; with no checked sales, a move shows only if it's 60% or less and the lowest listing moved the same way. A card not on it may have moved less, more, or without its lowest listing. Original printings: the raw 2003 Crystal Lugia wasn't on either list through Oct 5. Our only look at an original is the Sep 28 File on Crystal Lugia PSA 8 (eBay sales through Sep 27): a different grade, venue and window, so it isn't set against the Classic Collection Lugia. Unconfirmed: no sale checked by Mission Control's Sale Integrity Layer in that window. Not advice.

flags.text: Mission Control hasn't checked a sale behind any move on the board's first 7-day list, these four included. With no checked sales, a move shows only if it's 60% or less over 7 days and TCGplayer's lowest listing moved the same way, by an amount we don't publish (it can be a cent).
flags.stat: No sale checked behind any of the four, or any other move on the list. Not a read on whether these prices are high or low.
